title: Spinner Dolphins Can Spin Seven Times in a Single Leap

scenes.text: This dolphin can spin seven times in one leap.
It launches itself up to three metres out of the water.
Then it twists along the length of its body, over and over, in mid-air.
That is why it is called the spinner dolphin.
Guinness World Records lists seven aerial spins as the most for a dolphin.
Seven spins. One jump. Now watch it again.
